```plato

    // Rescale so the real part has unit magnitude, restoring the motor
    // invariant after repeated products. Precondition: the real part is not
    // zero.
    Normalize(m: Motor3D): Motor3D {
        var scale = 1.0 / m.Real.Length;
        return (m.Real * scale, m.Dual * scale);
    }
```

```plato
    // Rescale to unit magnitude, restoring the rotor invariant after repeated
    // products. Precondition: the rotor is not the zero element.
    Normalize(r: Rotor2D): Rotor2D {
        var m = (r.Scalar.Square + r.XY.Square).Sqrt;
        return (r.Scalar / m, r.XY / m);
    }
```
